g.text: How the five-model risk-aware search works

text.style: font-size: 10.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #526174

g.text: Five trained models evaluate the same state. Each prediction enters its own percentile tracker before disagreement is computed.
Schematic only: no fabricated per-state scores. The implemented risk setting is κ = 1 and C = 50.
Disagreement is a search signal; it is not a demonstrated Gaussian interval over true distance.
